# Temple Scroll Column 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 11 | **Condition:** heavily damaged / fragmentary

---

**11:1** [...] on the first day of the seventh month there shall be for you a holy convocation [...]

**11:2** [...] all laborious work you shall not do [...]

**11:3** [...] it shall be for you a day of remembrance with blasts of trumpets [...]

**11:4** [...] a memorial before Me [...]

**11:5** [...] and you shall bring near a burnt offering, a fire offering of soothing aroma to the LORD [...]

**11:6** [...] one young bull, son of the herd, one ram [...]

**11:7** [...] seven lambs, sons of a year, without blemish [...]

**11:8** [...] and their grain offering: fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenths for the bull [...]

**11:9** [...] two-tenths for the ram [...]

**11:10** [...] and one-tenth for each lamb, of the seven lambs [...]

**11:11** [...] and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement upon you [...]

**11:12** [...] besides the burnt offering of the new moon and its grain offering [...]

**11:13** [...] and the perpetual burnt offering and its grain offering and their drink offerings [...]

**11:14** [...] according to their ordinance, a fire offering of soothing aroma to the LORD [...]

**11:15** [...] it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations [...]

**11:16** [...] in all your dwelling places [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 11 is heavily damaged with extensive lacunae at the beginning and end of most lines. Content parallels Numbers 29:1-6 but recast in divine first-person address characteristic of the Temple Scroll. Preserved fragments concern the Day of Remembrance (yom teru'ah) — the first day of the seventh month. "Sons of a year" preserves the Hebrew bene shanah idiom. "Bring near" (hiqriv) rendered literally for the sacrificial technical term.*
